scope: Standing Linh Phước Temple in Trại Mát, including the 37-metre seven-level bell tower, low layered tiled entrance, worship hall and adjacent public-facing courtyard ranges.

originalReview.notes: The photographer released this exact original in its first revision at upload. Consulted the architecture, including white-and-ochre trim, dark blue curved roofs, tiered towers and the open central approach. Incidental figurative sculpture and artwork were excluded from the modeling reference.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed the published Qualla media first. The exact Diane Selwyn photograph has an original, direct public-domain dedication. Uncertain transfer histories, images dominated by figurative artwork, and unrelated venues were excluded.
